answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 46763 Country: India Title: inheritance Question: My father expired this year. He is survived by his wife and 3 sons. He left behind a house. We are getting rent from that house. We want to share that among 4 of us. So tell me how to do it according to Shariah. If we sell in future, what is the rule according to Shariah? Answer ID: 46763 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1104/1117/M=9/1434) If your grandparents also have died and your father was survived only by your mother and you three sons; then you should distribute the rent of the house or price of the house in case you sell it in 24 shares. Out of the 24 shares, the deceased’s wife (your mother) will receive 3 shares and each of three sons will have 7-7 shares. Details: Wife 1x3= 3 3 Sons 3x7= 21 Total: 24 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
